They are designed to support performance and fuel efficiency when fitted correctly.
Dimensions and surface finish are verified before packing.

Yes, after a feasibility review by our engineers.

Yes. Mixed shipments labelled by model are common.

Yes. Our support team can answer installation and upkeep questions so your mechanics fit the parts correctly.

Yes. Our engine parts are used in both passenger and cargo three-wheelers, which work under heavier loads for long hours.
